issue.title: Claude Code spawn intermittently fails: 'fork/exec …/claude: permission denied' (502), file and permissions look fine
issue.body:
## What happens

Requests to `/v1/chat/completions` for `claude/*` models intermittently fail with HTTP 502:

```
Claude Code: fork/exec /home/coder/.npm-global/bin/claude: permission denied
```

It comes in bursts (several requests in a row, each retried 3 times by the client), then clears on its own. Roughly 6 bursts in 2 days: 10-26 10:14, 10:27, 10:47, 14:01–14:07, and 10-27 08:45, 09:25 (CST). Mostly `claude-haiku-5-5`, once `claude-sonnet-5-5`.

## Why it looks like a magpie-side problem

- The failing requests never log `Claude Code pid … started`, so the failure is at spawn time.
- Same binary, same user, minutes apart: other requests start `claude` fine. 8 fresh `claude-haiku-5-5` requests in a row via curl all succeeded; streaming, tools and system prompts made no difference.
- `claude.exe` is `-rwxr-xr-x coder`, and its ctime and every parent directory's ctime did not change around the failures. `/home/coder` is `drwx------ coder`, and magpie runs as `coder`, so path traversal is fine. SELinux is disabled, and there is no `noexec` mount.
- The unit has no sandboxing: `ProtectHome=no`, `ProtectSystem=no`, `NoNewPrivileges=no`.
- Only one magpie process listens on :3425.
- The client is Hermes Agent (OpenAI Python SDK, `chat_completions`, small requests of 2–7 messages).

## Environment

- magpie 0.1.1649 (`magpie web --addr 127.0.0.1:3430 --no-open`, systemd, user `coder`, `HOME=/var/lib/paseo`)
- CentOS Stream 9 (kernel 5.14), x86_64, 3.6 GB RAM
- Claude Code 2.1.296 installed via npm (global, under `/home/coder/.npm-global`)
- Claude Code runs in `/tmp/magpie-claude-work-1000` (`drwx------ coder`)

## Ask

Could magpie log the exact `os/exec` step that returned EACCES (executable vs working directory vs something else) and retry once before returning 502? Go reports a `chdir` failure in the child as `fork/exec <path>: permission denied`, so the message points at the binary even when the real cause is the working directory. If the working directory can be recreated or cleaned while a run starts, that might be the cause, but I could not confirm it.

comments.body:
Found the cause and a minimal repro. It's the working directory that magpie takes from the system prompt, not the `claude` binary.

magpie reads `Current working directory: <path>` (also `Primary working directory:`, `<cwd>…</cwd>`) from the request and uses it as the Claude Code process's directory. If `<path>` exists and can be `stat`ed, but the magpie user cannot enter it, Go's `fork/exec` fails in the child `chdir` and reports it as:

```
Claude Code: fork/exec /home/coder/.npm-global/bin/claude: permission denied
```

Repro (magpie runs as user `coder`; `/root` is `dr-xr-x--- root root`, so `stat /root` works but `chdir /root` does not):

```
curl http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/chat/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"claude/claude-haiku-5-5","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"Current working directory: /root"},{"role":"user","content":"say ok"}]}'
# -> 502 ... fork/exec .../claude: permission denied
```

The same request with `Current working directory: /root/.hermes/hermes-agent` returns `ok`, because `stat` already fails there and magpie falls back. A directory like `/tmp/x` with mode 644 (stat ok, no search permission) also fails the same way.

That explains why it was intermittent: it depended on which client session's prompt carried `/root`.

Suggested fix: when choosing the work directory, check that it is searchable by the current user (e.g. `unix.Access(path, X_OK)`, or a probe `chdir`) and fall back to the default work dir. Also report a chdir failure as such instead of blaming the binary.

Fixed on a fork branch: `fix/3812-workdir-enterable` (head `e2958536`, on upstream `6eb510f7`) — a non-enterable working directory falls back to magpie's.

**Root cause.** `internal/gateway/claude_subscription.go`'s `clientWorkDir` accepted a directory `os.Stat` could see, and a directory that can be stat-ed but not entered (mode 0644, a sandbox parent) then failed the spawn with `fork/exec …: permission denied` (502).

**Change.** the probe is `os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, "."))` — resolving `.` inside a directory needs search permission — and the function falls back to magpie's own work directory when it fails, the fallback it already had.

**Verified.** Red: `go test -tags nogui ./internal/gateway/ (the claude workdir test)` → the chmod-0644 project directory answered 502 `fork/exec …: permission denied`
Green: `same command → `ok`: 200 in magpie's work dir; the case is skipped when the tests run as root (root enters anything)` → `ok github.com/yenone/magpie/internal/gateway`

Full `go test -tags nogui ./...` over round 27's branches: 70 packages ok, 5 red (edit `TestWriteAtomicReadOnlyHardLink`, gateway's five, plugin `TestPluginSOCKSProxy`, provider's synctest fatal in `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials`, testenv `TestProgram`) — every one of them reproduces identically at base `6eb510f7` in this environment (umask 0027), so none is from this change.

Branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3812-workdir-enterable — no PR opened, this repo takes no external PRs; say the word if you'd rather have the patch inline here.
